audience: Brazilian businesses that track payables, receivables and cash flow in Granatum

useCases.title: See which bills are due and still unpaid
useCases.text: List the transactions for a date range and a payment type, such as to pay or overdue. Open one to read its amount, dates and category.

useCases.title: Check the balances of the bank accounts
useCases.text: List the company bank accounts with their balances. Open one account to read its details.

useCases.title: Review cash flow and profit and loss
useCases.text: Read the cash flow report and the profit and loss report for a date range.

useCases.title: Track customer charges and their status
useCases.text: List the customer charges created with Granatum Pagamentos, by customer, due date or status. Look up the customer records behind them.

useCases.title: Record a new income or expense
useCases.text: Create an income or expense transaction. A negative amount records an expense and a positive amount records income. This writes financial data, so confirm the amount first.

useCases.title: Correct an existing transaction
useCases.text: Read a transaction, then change only the fields that need correction. Set propagate_to_installments to apply the change to later installments.
